title: GCB App
description: Designing a mobile banking experience that feels clear, fast, and trustworthy.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Making everyday banking feel like less of a chore
body: With a banking app, you just want to do what you came to do and get out, like checking your balance or sending money to someone quickly, so we wanted to strip out all the extra friction. But banking apps are tricky because when people are dealing with their money, they get anxious if the app is too fast or doesn't explain what's happening, so we had to build something that feels fast but also gives you that reassurance at every step.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Finding the balance between speed and reassurance
body: When we talked to users, we realized they weren't just asking for things to load faster. They actually wanted to feel sure that their money went to the right place, so we saw people hesitating at the final button because the confirmation screen looked too vague. I restructured the navigation so the things people actually do every day are right there, and then we simplified the page layouts so the status of your money is always obvious.
bullets: People were holding back on sending money because the screens didn't explicitly say 'Sent successfully'.
We cleaned up the menu labels to use terms people actually say, instead of internal banking jargon.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: A faster flow that doesn't leave you guessing
body: We ended up rebuilding the core flows to show key information on a single screen without making people jump back and forth. Now, the dashboard highlights your actual balance and recent activity first, and sending money takes fewer taps with a clear, high-contrast confirmation at the end so you know exactly where your transaction stands.
bullets: Saves taps by keeping the sender's account context visible throughout the transfer.
Clear confirmation screen that spells out the exact transfer details immediately.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Fintech is more about clarity than speed
body: This project really showed me that in fintech, speed is nice but clarity is what actually builds trust. Making small tweaks to how we showed transaction states and grouping elements better did more for user confidence than just making the app load faster. In the end, good design is about making people feel secure when they're interacting with their money.
bullets: Adaptive UI controls and framerate-optimized ambient layers ensure responsive, high-contrast feedback on mobile viewports.
